active_ingredient: Vitamin B12 1000 mcg as cyanocobalamin per nugget
usage: Adults take one nugget daily, preferably with a meal; place between cheek and gum, under the tongue, or chew.
warnings: Consult a healthcare practitioner before use if pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or managing a medical condition.
Discontinue use and consult a healthcare practitioner if adverse reactions occur.
Keep out of reach of children.
Do not use if the outer bottle seal is missing or damaged.
